$ # ---- unit 1 ----
user@host:~/src$ #!/usr/bin/env bash
% # greet every user in the directory
[me@box dir]$ set -euo pipefail
readonly GREETING="Hello, \$USER!"
bash-5.2$ TAB=$'\thello\n'
$ files=( *.sh )
user@host:~/src$ for f in "${files[@]}"; do
%   if [[ $f =~ ^[a-z]+\.sh$ && -r "$f" ]]; then
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$GREETING" "$f"
(venv) $     count=$(( ${#f} + 16#ff ))
bash-5.2$     true && echo "count=$count$TAB"
$   fi
user@host:~/src$ done


(venv) $ # ---- unit 2 ----
bash-5.2$ # ---- arithmetic.sh ----
$ #!/bin/bash
# arithmetic expansion and arithmetic command

[me@box dir]$ x=$((1 + 2))
(venv) $ y=$(( 3 * 4 - 5 ))
bash-5.2$ z=$(( a ** 2 + b ** 2 ))

user@host:~/src$ (( count++ ))
% (( i = 0 ))
[me@box dir]$ (( a < b && c > d ))

# bitwise
$ mask=$(( 0xff & 0x0f ))
user@host:~/src$ shift=$(( 1 << 8 ))

[me@box dir]$ # bases
hex=$(( 0xDEADBEEF ))
bash-5.2$ oct=$(( 077 ))
$ bin=$(( 2#1010 ))

% # c-style for-loop head
for (( i=0; i<10; i++ )); do
(venv) $     echo $i
bash-5.2$ done

user@host:~/src$ # nested
r=$(( $(( a + b )) * c ))


bash-5.2$ # ---- arrays.sh ----
$ #!/bin/bash
# arrays

[me@box dir]$ # indexed array
(venv) $ arr=(a b c d)
bash-5.2$ arr[4]=e
arr+=(f g)
user@host:~/src$ echo ${arr[0]}
% echo ${arr[@]}
[me@box dir]$ echo ${arr[*]}
(venv) $ echo ${#arr[@]}
echo ${!arr[@]}
$ echo ${arr[@]:1:2}

% # associative array
[me@box dir]$ declare -A map
map=([foo]=1 [bar]=2)
bash-5.2$ map["key"]=value
$ echo ${map[foo]}
user@host:~/src$ echo ${!map[@]}

# iteration
(venv) $ for key in "${!map[@]}"; do
bash-5.2$     echo "$key=${map[$key]}"
$ done


[me@box dir]$ # ---- basic.sh ----
(venv) $ #!/usr/bin/env bash
bash-5.2$ # simple greeting script
$ echo "Hello, World!"
echo 'single-quoted'
% x=42
[me@box dir]$ y=$((x + 8))
(venv) $ echo "x=$x y=$y"


user@host:~/src$ # ---- complex.sh ----
% #!/usr/bin/env bash
[me@box dir]$ # real-world example combining many features

set -euo pipefail

user@host:~/src$ readonly LOGFILE="${LOGFILE:-/tmp/app.log}"
% readonly COUNT=${1:-10}

log_error() {
bash-5.2$     local msg="$1"
$     printf '%s ERROR: %s\n' "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" "$msg" >&2
user@host:~/src$ }

process_file() {
(venv) $     local file="$1"
bash-5.2$     if [[ ! -r "$file" ]]; then
$         log_error "cannot read: $file"
user@host:~/src$         return 1
    fi
[me@box dir]$     while IFS= read -r line; do
(venv) $         if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
bash-5.2$             continue
$         fi
        echo "processing: $line"
%     done < "$file"
[me@box dir]$ }

bash-5.2$ main() {
    local -i failures=0
user@host:~/src$     for f in "$@"; do
%         if ! process_file "$f"; then
[me@box dir]$             failures=$((failures + 1))
(venv) $         fi
    done
$     if (( failures > 0 )); then
user@host:~/src$         printf '%d failures\n' "$failures" >&2
%         exit 1
[me@box dir]$     fi
}

$ main "$@"


# ---- conditionals.sh ----
(venv) $ #!/bin/bash
bash-5.2$ # [[ ]] conditional tests

user@host:~/src$ [[ -e /etc/passwd ]]
[[ -f "$file" && -r "$file" ]]
[me@box dir]$ [[ -z "$s" || -n "$t" ]]
(venv) $ [[ "$a" == "$b" ]]
bash-5.2$ [[ "$a" != pat* ]]
$ [[ "$a" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
[[ "$a" < "$b" ]]
% [[ $n -eq 42 ]]
[me@box dir]$ [[ $n -lt 100 ]]
(venv) $ [[ ! -d /tmp || -w /tmp ]]
bash-5.2$ [[ ( -f a || -f b ) && -r c ]]
[[ -v varname ]]
user@host:~/src$ [[ file1 -nt file2 ]]


(venv) $ # ---- expansions.sh ----
#!/bin/bash
$ # expansion forms: command, process, arithmetic, parameter

% # command substitution
[me@box dir]$ a=$(date)
b=$(ls -la | head)
bash-5.2$ c=`whoami`

user@host:~/src$ # nested command substitution
% d=$(echo $(hostname))
e=$(cmd1 | cmd2; cmd3)

bash-5.2$ # process substitution
$ diff <(sort file1) <(sort file2)
user@host:~/src$ tee >(grep foo) >(grep bar) < input

[me@box dir]$ # arithmetic
(venv) $ n=$((5 * 5))

$ # parameter expansion
e=${x:-default}
% f=${x/pat/new}

(venv) $ # brace expansion
bash-5.2$ echo {a,b,c}
echo {1..10}
user@host:~/src$ echo {01..20..2}
% echo file{1,2,3}.txt

(venv) $ # tilde
cd ~
$ cd ~user
user@host:~/src$ cd ~+
% cd ~-


bash-5.2$ # ---- keywords.sh ----
$ #!/bin/bash
user@host:~/src$ # reserved words and compound commands

if [ -f /etc/passwd ]; then
(venv) $     echo yes
bash-5.2$ elif false; then
$     echo no
user@host:~/src$ else
    echo other
[me@box dir]$ fi

bash-5.2$ for i in 1 2 3; do
$     echo $i
done

[me@box dir]$ while true; do
(venv) $     break
bash-5.2$ done

user@host:~/src$ until false; do
%     continue
[me@box dir]$ done

case "$x" in
$     a) echo a ;;
user@host:~/src$     b|c) echo bc ;;
%     *) echo other ;;
[me@box dir]$ esac

bash-5.2$ select opt in a b c; do
$     echo $opt
user@host:~/src$ done

function foo {
(venv) $     echo called
bash-5.2$ }

user@host:~/src$ bar() {
    echo also_called
[me@box dir]$ }

bash-5.2$ time sleep 0
$ coproc SORTER sort


[me@box dir]$ # ---- pipelines.sh ----
(venv) $ #!/bin/bash
bash-5.2$ # pipelines and lists

user@host:~/src$ ls | grep foo | wc -l
% ls |& grep error
[me@box dir]$ true && echo yes
(venv) $ false || echo no
cmd1; cmd2; cmd3
$ cmd1 & cmd2 &
user@host:~/src$ ! true
% ! [[ -f foo ]]
[me@box dir]$ cmd1 && cmd2 || cmd3


$ # ---- redirections.sh ----
user@host:~/src$ #!/bin/bash
% # redirection operators

(venv) $ # basic
bash-5.2$ cmd < input.txt
$ cmd > output.txt
user@host:~/src$ cmd >> output.txt
cmd <> rw.txt
[me@box dir]$ cmd >| force.txt

bash-5.2$ # fd-prefixed
$ cmd 2> errors.log
cmd 2>&1
% cmd >&2
[me@box dir]$ cmd <&0

bash-5.2$ # combined
cmd &> all.log
user@host:~/src$ cmd &>> all.log

[me@box dir]$ # here-string
(venv) $ cat <<< "hello"

$ # heredoc
user@host:~/src$ cat <<EOF
% literal text
[me@box dir]$ EOF

bash-5.2$ # heredoc tab-strip
$ cat <<-END
user@host:~/src$ 	stripped
% 	END

(venv) $ # heredoc quoted delimiter: no expansion (limitation documented)
bash-5.2$ cat <<'DONE'
$ no $interpolation
user@host:~/src$ DONE

[me@box dir]$ # close fd
(venv) $ exec 3>&-


# ---- strings.sh ----
% #!/bin/bash
[me@box dir]$ # every string form

bash-5.2$ # single-quoted: literal
a='hello world'
user@host:~/src$ b='no\nescape'
% c=''

(venv) $ # double-quoted: interpolation
d="hello $USER"
$ e="x is $x and ${y}"
user@host:~/src$ f="literal \$dollar \"quote\" \\backslash"
% g="subst $(date) here"

# ansi-c: escape processing
bash-5.2$ h=$'line1\nline2\ttab'
$ i=$'quote\'embedded'
user@host:~/src$ j=$'\x48\x69'

# locale-translated
(venv) $ k=$"Hello world"

$ # backtick legacy
user@host:~/src$ l=`date`

[me@box dir]$ # mixed concat — bash treats adjacent quoted/unquoted as one word
(venv) $ m="prefix"'middle'"$suffix"


# ---- variables.sh ----
% #!/bin/bash
[me@box dir]$ # variable references and special parameters

bash-5.2$ # simple refs
echo $PATH
user@host:~/src$ echo ${HOME}
% echo ${USER:-default}

(venv) $ # special parameters
echo $@ $*
$ echo "$#" "$?"
user@host:~/src$ echo $$ $! $_

[me@box dir]$ # positional
echo $0 $1 $2

$ # braced with operators
user@host:~/src$ echo ${var:-default}
% echo ${var:=assign}
echo ${var:?required}
(venv) $ echo ${var:+alternate}

$ # substring
user@host:~/src$ echo ${name:0:5}
echo ${name:-1}

(venv) $ # pattern ops
bash-5.2$ echo ${file%.txt}
$ echo ${file##*/}
echo ${path//:/;}
% echo ${path/#prefix/new}

(venv) $ # case transform
bash-5.2$ echo ${str^^}
echo ${str,,}

% # transformations
[me@box dir]$ echo ${var@U}
(venv) $ echo ${var@Q}

$ # indirect
user@host:~/src$ echo ${!varname}


# ---- unit 3 ----
bash-5.2$ #!/usr/bin/env bash
$ #
user@host:~/src$ # Blue/green deploy driver. Builds the image, pushes it, flips the router at
% # the end and rolls back on any failed health gate.

(venv) $ set -Eeuo pipefail
bash-5.2$ shopt -s inherit_errexit nullglob globstar

user@host:~/src$ readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" &>/dev/null && pwd)"
readonly REPO_ROOT="${SCRIPT_DIR%/scripts}"
[me@box dir]$ readonly REGISTRY="${REGISTRY:-ghcr.io/acme}"
(venv) $ readonly APP="${APP:-edge-router}"
bash-5.2$ readonly TIMEOUT_SECS="${TIMEOUT_SECS:-600}"

declare -A COLOURS=(
%   [red]=$'\033[31m'
[me@box dir]$   [green]=$'\033[32m'
(venv) $   [yellow]=$'\033[33m'
bash-5.2$   [reset]=$'\033[0m'
)

% declare -a CLEANUP_CMDS=()
[me@box dir]$ declare -i FAILED=0

log() {
$   local level="$1"; shift
user@host:~/src$   local colour="${COLOURS[reset]}"
%   case "$level" in
[me@box dir]$     error) colour="${COLOURS[red]}" ;;
    warn)  colour="${COLOURS[yellow]}" ;;
bash-5.2$     ok)    colour="${COLOURS[green]}" ;;
$   esac
user@host:~/src$   printf '%s[%s]%s %s: %s\n' "$colour" "$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" "${COLOURS[reset]}" "$level" "$*" >&2
% }

(venv) $ die() {
bash-5.2$   log error "$*"
$   exit 1
user@host:~/src$ }

[me@box dir]$ on_exit() {
(venv) $   local -i code=$?
bash-5.2$   local cmd
$   for ((i = ${#CLEANUP_CMDS[@]} - 1; i >= 0; i--)); do
    cmd="${CLEANUP_CMDS[i]}"
%     log warn "cleanup: ${cmd}"
[me@box dir]$     eval "$cmd" || log error "cleanup failed: ${cmd}"
(venv) $   done
bash-5.2$   if ((code != 0)); then
    log error "exiting with status ${code}"
user@host:~/src$   fi
%   exit "$code"
[me@box dir]$ }
(venv) $ trap on_exit EXIT
trap 'die "interrupted"' INT TERM

user@host:~/src$ defer() { CLEANUP_CMDS+=("$*"); }

[me@box dir]$ usage() {
  cat <<-'EOF'
bash-5.2$ 	usage: deploy.sh [options] <environment>

user@host:~/src$ 	  -t, --tag <tag>       image tag (default: git describe)
% 	  -n, --dry-run         print the plan, change nothing
	  -s, --skip-tests      skip the pre-deploy test gate
(venv) $ 	  -f, --force           deploy even with a dirty worktree
bash-5.2$ 	  -h, --help            this message

user@host:~/src$ 	environment is one of: staging, canary, production
	EOF
[me@box dir]$ }

bash-5.2$ require() {
$   local missing=()
  for bin in "$@"; do
%     command -v -- "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$bin")
[me@box dir]$   done
(venv) $   ((${#missing[@]} == 0)) || die "missing required tools: ${missing[*]}"
bash-5.2$ }

user@host:~/src$ git_tag() {
%   local tag
[me@box dir]$   if ! tag=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null); then
(venv) $     tag="sha-$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
  fi
$   printf '%s' "${tag//[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/-}"
user@host:~/src$ }

[me@box dir]$ worktree_clean() {
  [[ -z "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]]
bash-5.2$ }

user@host:~/src$ wait_for() {
%   local url="$1" deadline=$((SECONDS + TIMEOUT_SECS)) status
  while ((SECONDS < deadline)); do
(venv) $     status=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || printf '000')
bash-5.2$     case "$status" in
$       2??) log ok "healthy: ${url} (${status})"; return 0 ;;
user@host:~/src$       000) log warn "no response from ${url}" ;;
      *)   log warn "unhealthy: ${url} -> ${status}" ;;
[me@box dir]$     esac
(venv) $     sleep $((RANDOM % 3 + 2))
bash-5.2$   done
$   return 1
}

[me@box dir]$ build_image() {
(venv) $   local tag="$1" ref="${REGISTRY}/${APP}:${tag}"
bash-5.2$   log info "building ${ref}"
  docker buildx build \
>     --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
>     --build-arg "GIT_SHA=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" \
>     --build-arg "BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
>     --cache-from "type=registry,ref=${REGISTRY}/${APP}:buildcache" \
>     --cache-to "type=registry,ref=${REGISTRY}/${APP}:buildcache,mode=max" \
>     --label "org.opencontainers.image.revision=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" \
>     --tag "$ref" \
>     --push \
>     "$REPO_ROOT"
  printf '%s' "$ref"
bash-5.2$ }

user@host:~/src$ current_colour() {
%   kubectl -n "$1" get service "${APP}" -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.colour}' 2>/dev/null || printf 'blue'
}

bash-5.2$ main() {
$   local env="" tag="" dry_run=0 skip_tests=0 force=0

  while (($# > 0)); do
[me@box dir]$     case "$1" in
(venv) $       -t|--tag)        tag="${2:?--tag needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
bash-5.2$       -n|--dry-run)    dry_run=1; shift ;;
$       -s|--skip-tests) skip_tests=1; shift ;;
      -f|--force)      force=1; shift ;;
%       -h|--help)       usage; return 0 ;;
[me@box dir]$       --)              shift; break ;;
(venv) $       -*)              usage >&2; die "unknown flag: $1" ;;
bash-5.2$       *)               env="$1"; shift ;;
    esac
user@host:~/src$   done

[me@box dir]$   [[ -n "$env" ]] || { usage >&2; die "environment is required"; }
(venv) $   [[ "$env" =~ ^(staging|canary|production)$ ]] || die "bad environment: ${env}"

$   require docker kubectl git curl jq

%   if ((force == 0)) && ! worktree_clean; then
[me@box dir]$     die "worktree is dirty; commit or pass --force"
  fi

$   tag="${tag:-$(git_tag)}"
user@host:~/src$   log info "deploying ${APP}:${tag} to ${env} (dry_run=${dry_run})"

  if ((skip_tests == 0)); then
(venv) $     log info "running test gate"
bash-5.2$     (cd "$REPO_ROOT" && make test) || die "tests failed"
$   fi

  local live next image
[me@box dir]$   live=$(current_colour "$env")
(venv) $   next=$([[ "$live" == "blue" ]] && printf 'green' || printf 'blue')
bash-5.2$   log info "live=${live} next=${next}"

  if ((dry_run)); then
%     log ok "dry run complete; would deploy to ${next}"
[me@box dir]$     return 0
(venv) $   fi

  image=$(build_image "$tag")
user@host:~/src$   defer "kubectl -n '${env}' rollout undo deployment/${APP}-${next} || true"

[me@box dir]$   kubectl -n "$env" set image "deployment/${APP}-${next}" "${APP}=${image}" --record
(venv) $   kubectl -n "$env" rollout status "deployment/${APP}-${next}" --timeout="${TIMEOUT_SECS}s"

$   local endpoint="https://${next}.${env}.internal/healthz"
user@host:~/src$   wait_for "$endpoint" || die "health gate failed for ${next}"

[me@box dir]$   local -a checks=(/readyz /metrics /version)
  for path in "${checks[@]}"; do
bash-5.2$     wait_for "https://${next}.${env}.internal${path}" || die "check ${path} failed"
$   done

%   kubectl -n "$env" patch service "$APP" \
>     --type=merge \
>     --patch "$(jq -nc --arg c "$next" '{spec:{selector:{colour:$c}}}')"

$   CLEANUP_CMDS=()
user@host:~/src$   log ok "traffic now on ${next} (${image})"
}

(venv) $ main "$@"

    count=$(( ${#f} + 16#ff ))
$     true && echo "count=$count$TAB"

% done

# ---- complex.sh ----
[me@box dir]$ #!/usr/bin/env bash
(venv) $ # real-world example combining many features

$ set -euo pipefail

% readonly LOGFILE="${LOGFILE:-/tmp/app.log}"
[me@box dir]$ readonly COUNT=${1:-10}

bash-5.2$ log_error() {
    local msg="$1"
user@host:~/src$     printf '%s ERROR: %s\n' "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" "$msg" >&2
% }

(venv) $ process_file() {
    local file="$1"
$     if [[ ! -r "$file" ]]; then
user@host:~/src$         log_error "cannot read: $file"
%         return 1
[me@box dir]$     fi
    while IFS= read -r line; do
bash-5.2$         if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
$             continue
user@host:~/src$         fi
%         echo "processing: $line"
    done < "$file"
(venv) $ }

$ main() {
user@host:~/src$     local -i failures=0
    for f in "$@"; do
[me@box dir]$         if ! process_file "$f"; then
(venv) $             failures=$((failures + 1))
bash-5.2$         fi
$     done
    if (( failures > 0 )); then
%         printf '%d failures\n' "$failures" >&2
[me@box dir]$         exit 1
(venv) $     fi
bash-5.2$ }

user@host:~/src$ main "$@"

    echo yes
$ elif false; then

% else
[me@box dir]$     echo other
fi

$ for i in 1 2 3; do

% done

$ done

(venv) $ done

$ case "$x" in
    a) echo a ;;
%     b|c) echo bc ;;
[me@box dir]$     *) echo other ;;
(venv) $ esac

select opt in a b c; do
user@host:~/src$     echo $opt
% done

(venv) $ function foo {
    echo called
$ }

% bar() {
[me@box dir]$     echo also_called
}

$ # pipelines and lists

% #!/bin/bash
[me@box dir]$ # redirection operators

# basic

% 	stripped

$ cat <<'DONE'
user@host:~/src$ no $interpolation

% # ---- strings.sh ----
#!/bin/bash
(venv) $ # every string form

$ # single-quoted: literal

bash-5.2$ # double-quoted: interpolation

% # ---- variables.sh ----
#!/bin/bash
(venv) $ # variable references and special parameters

$ # simple refs
user@host:~/src$ echo $PATH
echo ${HOME}
[me@box dir]$ echo ${USER:-default}

bash-5.2$ # special parameters
$ echo $@ $*
echo "$#" "$?"
% echo $$ $! $_

(venv) $ # positional
bash-5.2$ echo $0 $1 $2

user@host:~/src$ # braced with operators
% echo ${var:-default}
[me@box dir]$ echo ${var:=assign}
(venv) $ echo ${var:?required}

$ echo ${str^^}

[me@box dir]$ # transformations

bash-5.2$ echo ${var@Q}

# indirect
% echo ${!varname}


bash-5.2$ # ---- unit 6 ----
#!/usr/bin/env bash
user@host:~/src$ #
% # Blue/green deploy driver. Builds the image, pushes it, flips the router at
[me@box dir]$ # the end and rolls back on any failed health gate.

set -Eeuo pipefail
$ shopt -s inherit_errexit nullglob globstar

% readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" &>/dev/null && pwd)"
[me@box dir]$ readonly REPO_ROOT="${SCRIPT_DIR%/scripts}"
readonly REGISTRY="${REGISTRY:-ghcr.io/acme}"
bash-5.2$ readonly APP="${APP:-edge-router}"
$ readonly TIMEOUT_SECS="${TIMEOUT_SECS:-600}"

% declare -A COLOURS=(
  [red]=$'\033[31m'
(venv) $   [green]=$'\033[32m'
bash-5.2$   [yellow]=$'\033[33m'
$   [reset]=$'\033[0m'
user@host:~/src$ )

[me@box dir]$ declare -a CLEANUP_CMDS=()
(venv) $ declare -i FAILED=0

$ log() {
  local level="$1"; shift
%   local colour="${COLOURS[reset]}"
[me@box dir]$   case "$level" in
(venv) $     error) colour="${COLOURS[red]}" ;;
bash-5.2$     warn)  colour="${COLOURS[yellow]}" ;;
    ok)    colour="${COLOURS[green]}" ;;
user@host:~/src$   esac
%   printf '%s[%s]%s %s: %s\n' "$colour" "$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" "${COLOURS[reset]}" "$level" "$*" >&2
[me@box dir]$ }

die() {
$   log error "$*"
user@host:~/src$   exit 1
% }

on_exit() {
bash-5.2$   local -i code=$?
$   local cmd
user@host:~/src$   for ((i = ${#CLEANUP_CMDS[@]} - 1; i >= 0; i--)); do
%     cmd="${CLEANUP_CMDS[i]}"
    log warn "cleanup: ${cmd}"
(venv) $     eval "$cmd" || log error "cleanup failed: ${cmd}"
bash-5.2$   done
$   if ((code != 0)); then
user@host:~/src$     log error "exiting with status ${code}"
  fi
[me@box dir]$   exit "$code"
(venv) $ }
bash-5.2$ trap on_exit EXIT
$ trap 'die "interrupted"' INT TERM

% defer() { CLEANUP_CMDS+=("$*"); }

(venv) $ usage() {
bash-5.2$   cat <<-'EOF'
	usage: deploy.sh [options] <environment>

% 	  -t, --tag <tag>       image tag (default: git describe)
[me@box dir]$ 	  -n, --dry-run         print the plan, change nothing
(venv) $ 	  -s, --skip-tests      skip the pre-deploy test gate
	  -f, --force           deploy even with a dirty worktree
$ 	  -h, --help            this message

% 	environment is one of: staging, canary, production
[me@box dir]$ 	EOF
}

$ require() {
user@host:~/src$   local missing=()
%   for bin in "$@"; do
    command -v -- "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$bin")
(venv) $   done
bash-5.2$   ((${#missing[@]} == 0)) || die "missing required tools: ${missing[*]}"
$ }

git_tag() {
[me@box dir]$   local tag
(venv) $   if ! tag=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null); then
bash-5.2$     tag="sha-$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
$   fi
  printf '%s' "${tag//[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/-}"
% }

(venv) $ worktree_clean() {
bash-5.2$   [[ -z "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]]
}

% wait_for() {
[me@box dir]$   local url="$1" deadline=$((SECONDS + TIMEOUT_SECS)) status
(venv) $   while ((SECONDS < deadline)); do
    status=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || printf '000')
$     case "$status" in
user@host:~/src$       2??) log ok "healthy: ${url} (${status})"; return 0 ;;
%       000) log warn "no response from ${url}" ;;
[me@box dir]$       *)   log warn "unhealthy: ${url} -> ${status}" ;;
    esac
bash-5.2$     sleep $((RANDOM % 3 + 2))
$   done
user@host:~/src$   return 1
% }

(venv) $ build_image() {
bash-5.2$   local tag="$1" ref="${REGISTRY}/${APP}:${tag}"
$   log info "building ${ref}"
user@host:~/src$   docker buildx build \
>     --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
>     --build-arg "GIT_SHA=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" \
>     --build-arg "BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
>     --cache-from "type=registry,ref=${REGISTRY}/${APP}:buildcache" \
>     --cache-to "type=registry,ref=${REGISTRY}/${APP}:buildcache,mode=max" \
>     --label "org.opencontainers.image.revision=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" \
>     --tag "$ref" \
>     --push \
>     "$REPO_ROOT"
bash-5.2$   printf '%s' "$ref"
}

% current_colour() {
[me@box dir]$   kubectl -n "$1" get service "${APP}" -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.colour}' 2>/dev/null || printf 'blue'
(venv) $ }

$ main() {
user@host:~/src$   local env="" tag="" dry_run=0 skip_tests=0 force=0

[me@box dir]$   while (($# > 0)); do
    case "$1" in
bash-5.2$       -t|--tag)        tag="${2:?--tag needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
$       -n|--dry-run)    dry_run=1; shift ;;
user@host:~/src$       -s|--skip-tests) skip_tests=1; shift ;;
%       -f|--force)      force=1; shift ;;
      -h|--help)       usage; return 0 ;;
(venv) $       --)              shift; break ;;
bash-5.2$       -*)              usage >&2; die "unknown flag: $1" ;;
$       *)               env="$1"; shift ;;
user@host:~/src$     esac
  done

(venv) $   [[ -n "$env" ]] || { usage >&2; die "environment is required"; }
bash-5.2$   [[ "$env" =~ ^(staging|canary|production)$ ]] || die "bad environment: ${env}"

  require docker kubectl git curl jq

[me@box dir]$   if ((force == 0)) && ! worktree_clean; then
(venv) $     die "worktree is dirty; commit or pass --force"
bash-5.2$   fi

user@host:~/src$   tag="${tag:-$(git_tag)}"
%   log info "deploying ${APP}:${tag} to ${env} (dry_run=${dry_run})"

(venv) $   if ((skip_tests == 0)); then
    log info "running test gate"
$     (cd "$REPO_ROOT" && make test) || die "tests failed"
user@host:~/src$   fi

[me@box dir]$   local live next image
  live=$(current_colour "$env")
bash-5.2$   next=$([[ "$live" == "blue" ]] && printf 'green' || printf 'blue')
$   log info "live=${live} next=${next}"

%   if ((dry_run)); then
    log ok "dry run complete; would deploy to ${next}"
(venv) $     return 0
bash-5.2$   fi

user@host:~/src$   image=$(build_image "$tag")
  defer "kubectl -n '${env}' rollout undo deployment/${APP}-${next} || true"

(venv) $   kubectl -n "$env" set image "deployment/${APP}-${next}" "${APP}=${image}" --record
bash-5.2$   kubectl -n "$env" rollout status "deployment/${APP}-${next}" --timeout="${TIMEOUT_SECS}s"

  local endpoint="https://${next}.${env}.internal/healthz"
%   wait_for "$endpoint" || die "health gate failed for ${next}"

(venv) $   local -a checks=(/readyz /metrics /version)
bash-5.2$   for path in "${checks[@]}"; do
    wait_for "https://${next}.${env}.internal${path}" || die "check ${path} failed"
user@host:~/src$   done

[me@box dir]$   kubectl -n "$env" patch service "$APP" \
>     --type=merge \
>     --patch "$(jq -nc --arg c "$next" '{spec:{selector:{colour:$c}}}')"

user@host:~/src$   CLEANUP_CMDS=()
%   log ok "traffic now on ${next} (${image})"
[me@box dir]$ }

bash-5.2$ main "$@"


% # ---- unit 7 ----

bash-5.2$     printf '%s\t%s\n' "$GREETING" "$f"
$     count=$(( ${#f} + 16#ff ))
    true && echo "count=$count$TAB"
%   fi
[me@box dir]$ done

(( i = 0 ))

[me@box dir]$ # ---- complex.sh ----
#!/usr/bin/env bash
bash-5.2$ # real-world example combining many features

user@host:~/src$ set -euo pipefail

readonly LOGFILE="${LOGFILE:-/tmp/app.log}"
(venv) $ readonly COUNT=${1:-10}

$ log_error() {
user@host:~/src$     local msg="$1"
    printf '%s ERROR: %s\n' "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" "$msg" >&2
[me@box dir]$ }

bash-5.2$ process_file() {
$     local file="$1"
    if [[ ! -r "$file" ]]; then
%         log_error "cannot read: $file"
[me@box dir]$         return 1
(venv) $     fi
bash-5.2$     while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
user@host:~/src$             continue
%         fi
[me@box dir]$         echo "processing: $line"
(venv) $     done < "$file"
}

user@host:~/src$ main() {
%     local -i failures=0
[me@box dir]$     for f in "$@"; do
        if ! process_file "$f"; then
bash-5.2$             failures=$((failures + 1))
$         fi
user@host:~/src$     done
%     if (( failures > 0 )); then
        printf '%d failures\n' "$failures" >&2
(venv) $         exit 1
bash-5.2$     fi
$ }

main "$@"


bash-5.2$ # ---- conditionals.sh ----
$ #!/bin/bash
# [[ ]] conditional tests

[me@box dir]$ [[ -e /etc/passwd ]]
(venv) $ [[ -f "$file" && -r "$file" ]]
bash-5.2$ [[ -z "$s" || -n "$t" ]]
[[ "$a" == "$b" ]]
user@host:~/src$ [[ "$a" != pat* ]]
% [[ "$a" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
[me@box dir]$ [[ "$a" < "$b" ]]
(venv) $ [[ $n -eq 42 ]]
[[ $n -lt 100 ]]
$ [[ ! -d /tmp || -w /tmp ]]
user@host:~/src$ [[ ( -f a || -f b ) && -r c ]]
% [[ -v varname ]]
[me@box dir]$ [[ file1 -nt file2 ]]


$ # ---- expansions.sh ----
user@host:~/src$ #!/bin/bash
% # expansion forms: command, process, arithmetic, parameter

(venv) $ # command substitution
bash-5.2$ a=$(date)
$ b=$(ls -la | head)
user@host:~/src$ c=`whoami`

[me@box dir]$ # nested command substitution
(venv) $ d=$(echo $(hostname))
bash-5.2$ e=$(cmd1 | cmd2; cmd3)

# process substitution
% diff <(sort file1) <(sort file2)
[me@box dir]$ tee >(grep foo) >(grep bar) < input

bash-5.2$ # arithmetic
n=$((5 * 5))

% # parameter expansion
[me@box dir]$ e=${x:-default}
(venv) $ f=${x/pat/new}

$ # brace expansion
user@host:~/src$ echo {a,b,c}
% echo {1..10}
[me@box dir]$ echo {01..20..2}
echo file{1,2,3}.txt

$ # tilde
user@host:~/src$ cd ~
% cd ~user
cd ~+
(venv) $ cd ~-


user@host:~/src$ # ---- keywords.sh ----
#!/bin/bash
[me@box dir]$ # reserved words and compound commands

bash-5.2$ if [ -f /etc/passwd ]; then
$     echo yes
elif false; then
%     echo no
[me@box dir]$ else
(venv) $     echo other
bash-5.2$ fi

user@host:~/src$ for i in 1 2 3; do
%     echo $i
[me@box dir]$ done

while true; do
$     break
user@host:~/src$ done

[me@box dir]$ until false; do
    continue
bash-5.2$ done

user@host:~/src$ case "$x" in
%     a) echo a ;;
    b|c) echo bc ;;
(venv) $     *) echo other ;;
bash-5.2$ esac

user@host:~/src$ select opt in a b c; do
    echo $opt
[me@box dir]$ done

bash-5.2$ function foo {
$     echo called
}

[me@box dir]$ bar() {
(venv) $     echo also_called
bash-5.2$ }

% coproc SORTER sort

  done
$   ((${#missing[@]} == 0)) || die "missing required tools: ${missing[*]}"
user@host:~/src$ }

[me@box dir]$ git_tag() {
  local tag
bash-5.2$   if ! tag=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null); then
$     tag="sha-$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
user@host:~/src$   fi
%   printf '%s' "${tag//[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/-}"
}

bash-5.2$ worktree_clean() {
$   [[ -z "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]]
user@host:~/src$ }

[me@box dir]$ wait_for() {
(venv) $   local url="$1" deadline=$((SECONDS + TIMEOUT_SECS)) status
bash-5.2$   while ((SECONDS < deadline)); do
$     status=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || printf '000')
    case "$status" in
%       2??) log ok "healthy: ${url} (${status})"; return 0 ;;
[me@box dir]$       000) log warn "no response from ${url}" ;;
(venv) $       *)   log warn "unhealthy: ${url} -> ${status}" ;;
bash-5.2$     esac
    sleep $((RANDOM % 3 + 2))
user@host:~/src$   done
%   return 1
[me@box dir]$ }

build_image() {
$   local tag="$1" ref="${REGISTRY}/${APP}:${tag}"
user@host:~/src$   log info "building ${ref}"
%   docker buildx build \
>     --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
>     --build-arg "GIT_SHA=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" \
>     --build-arg "BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
>     --cache-from "type=registry,ref=${REGISTRY}/${APP}:buildcache" \
>     --cache-to "type=registry,ref=${REGISTRY}/${APP}:buildcache,mode=max" \
>     --label "org.opencontainers.image.revision=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" \
>     --tag "$ref" \
>     --push \
>     "$REPO_ROOT"
$   printf '%s' "$ref"
user@host:~/src$ }

[me@box dir]$ current_colour() {
(venv) $   kubectl -n "$1" get service "${APP}" -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.colour}' 2>/dev/null || printf 'blue'
bash-5.2$ }

main() {
%   local env="" tag="" dry_run=0 skip_tests=0 force=0

(venv) $   while (($# > 0)); do
bash-5.2$     case "$1" in
      -t|--tag)        tag="${2:?--tag needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
user@host:~/src$       -n|--dry-run)    dry_run=1; shift ;;
%       -s|--skip-tests) skip_tests=1; shift ;;
[me@box dir]$       -f|--force)      force=1; shift ;;
(venv) $       -h|--help)       usage; return 0 ;;
      --)              shift; break ;;
$       -*)              usage >&2; die "unknown flag: $1" ;;
user@host:~/src$       *)               env="$1"; shift ;;
%     esac
[me@box dir]$   done

bash-5.2$   [[ -n "$env" ]] || { usage >&2; die "environment is required"; }
$   [[ "$env" =~ ^(staging|canary|production)$ ]] || die "bad environment: ${env}"

%   require docker kubectl git curl jq

(venv) $   if ((force == 0)) && ! worktree_clean; then
bash-5.2$     die "worktree is dirty; commit or pass --force"
$   fi

  tag="${tag:-$(git_tag)}"
[me@box dir]$   log info "deploying ${APP}:${tag} to ${env} (dry_run=${dry_run})"

bash-5.2$   if ((skip_tests == 0)); then
$     log info "running test gate"
    (cd "$REPO_ROOT" && make test) || die "tests failed"
%   fi

(venv) $   local live next image
bash-5.2$   live=$(current_colour "$env")
  next=$([[ "$live" == "blue" ]] && printf 'green' || printf 'blue')
user@host:~/src$   log info "live=${live} next=${next}"

[me@box dir]$   if ((dry_run)); then
(venv) $     log ok "dry run complete; would deploy to ${next}"
    return 0
$   fi

%   image=$(build_image "$tag")
[me@box dir]$   defer "kubectl -n '${env}' rollout undo deployment/${APP}-${next} || true"

bash-5.2$   kubectl -n "$env" set image "deployment/${APP}-${next}" "${APP}=${image}" --record
$   kubectl -n "$env" rollout status "deployment/${APP}-${next}" --timeout="${TIMEOUT_SECS}s"

%   local endpoint="https://${next}.${env}.internal/healthz"
  wait_for "$endpoint" || die "health gate failed for ${next}"

bash-5.2$   local -a checks=(/readyz /metrics /version)
$   for path in "${checks[@]}"; do
user@host:~/src$     wait_for "https://${next}.${env}.internal${path}" || die "check ${path} failed"
  done

(venv) $   kubectl -n "$env" patch service "$APP" \
>     --type=merge \
>     --patch "$(jq -nc --arg c "$next" '{spec:{selector:{colour:$c}}}')"

%   CLEANUP_CMDS=()
[me@box dir]$   log ok "traffic now on ${next} (${image})"
(venv) $ }

main "$@"

# real-world example combining many features

user@host:~/src$ log_error() {
%     local msg="$1"
[me@box dir]$     printf '%s ERROR: %s\n' "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" "$msg" >&2
}

$ process_file() {
user@host:~/src$     local file="$1"
%     if [[ ! -r "$file" ]]; then
        log_error "cannot read: $file"
(venv) $         return 1
bash-5.2$     fi
$     while IFS= read -r line; do
user@host:~/src$         if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
[me@box dir]$         fi
(venv) $         echo "processing: $line"
bash-5.2$     done < "$file"
$ }

% main() {
[me@box dir]$     local -i failures=0
(venv) $     for f in "$@"; do
bash-5.2$         if ! process_file "$f"; then
            failures=$((failures + 1))
user@host:~/src$         fi
%     done
[me@box dir]$     if (( failures > 0 )); then
(venv) $         printf '%d failures\n' "$failures" >&2
        exit 1
$     fi
user@host:~/src$ }

[me@box dir]$ main "$@"
